asked.item: YouTube video published but not visible on channel page

verdict.reason: The FAQ explains that web app publishing defaults to Unlisted, which hides videos from the public channel page, and gives steps to change it.

steps.text: Publishing from the Blotato web app defaults to Unlisted unless you change the "Video privacy status" dropdown.
Unlisted and private videos do not appear on your public channel page, but they do exist in your account.
To change it, open YouTube Studio, click Content in the left sidebar, find your video, and check the Visibility column.
Then click the visibility value and change it to Public.
To publish as public from the start, set the "Video privacy status" dropdown to Public before publishing.
